answer.evidence: Sudden LOS 17 Oct 22:00 with stable Tx power/bias rules out Tx degradation; A-TX measures 0.34 dBm in spec but no light at B-ODF, localising fault to field fibre. Handheld OTDR from A ends at 18.203 km fibre and from B at 13.159 km fibre (sum 31.362 km fibre vs 30.48 km route, ratio 1.029, matching splice anchors e.g. SC-03 14.057/13.668=1.028), giving route 18.203/1.029=17.69 km, between SC-03 (13.668) and SC-04 (19.484), consistent with flooding near km 18. Trace falls from backscatter -4.87 dB at 18.20 km to noise -37.9 dB at 18.22 km with no continuation — a complete break. The 0.97 dB event at 8.33 km is the pre-existing G.652/G.655 splice at SC-02 and passed light until the break, so it is not the outage cause.
